name: Shepard
description: Infinite Shepard / Risset riser. Not a reverb swell: stacked octaves keep climbing forever. X = rise speed, Y = brightness / noise. Hold to build; release dumps the tone so the drop can hit.

params.name: PART
params.detail: How many octave layers stay audible

params.name: NOIS
params.detail: Air / noise layer for RMX-style spiral
